slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Magic Patterns, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Magic Patterns generates production-minded UI designs and interactive prototypes from natural-language prompts, aimed at product teams.
It bridges the gap between a rough idea and something engineers can build.
It's a paid tool included in Lenny's bundle.
slides.narration: Magic Patterns generates production-minded UI designs and interactive prototypes from natural-language prompts, aimed at product teams. It bridges the gap between a rough idea and something engineers can build. It's worth a look.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: mock up a clean interface for a classroom app idea to share with a developer or grant funder
SMB owners: visualize a website redesign or a new feature before paying for development
Community leaders: produce a polished prototype to show a board what a digital service could look like
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can mock up a clean interface for a classroom app idea to share with a developer or grant funder; SMB owners can visualize a website redesign or a new feature before paying for development; Community leaders can produce a polished prototype to show a board what a digital service could look like.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
